prioritized_fixes.description: Remove duplicate entries from codex_ledger.json based on the digest field
prioritized_fixes.command: Get-Content .\codex_ledger.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json | Sort-Object digest -Unique | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content .\codex_ledger.json -Encoding UTF8

prioritized_fixes.description: Add a check in seal_009.py to skip appending if the new digest already exists

rationale: Multiple identical entries for stone_006 have been appended, polluting the ledger and undermining audit integrity. Deduplicating the ledger and guarding the seal script against reappending the same digest will restore a clean chain and prevent future duplicates.
